PLAN "12-Week Fat Loss & Glycaemic Control"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "fat loss and glycaemic control"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation (Weeks 1-4)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Tuesday training 35m "Low-Intensity Cardio + Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 3m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 1x20m rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
          cat_cow 2x8 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 1x60s rpe 2 rest 15 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 1x60s rpe 2 rest 15 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 4m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:

          dumbbell_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds

NUTRITION
  ENERGY:
    target_calories 1700
    distribution:
      protein 30%
      carbs 35%
      fats 35%
  MEAL_TIMING:
    - pre_workout:
        carbs 25..35 g
        protein 20..30 g
        fats 5..10 g
        notes "Eat 60–120 min before training; choose low-GI carbs; monitor glucose; adjust if fasting glucose <90 mg/dL."
    - post_workout:
        carbs 25..35 g
        protein 25..35 g
        fats 5..10 g
        notes "Within 1–2 h post; emphasize fiber and lean protein; hydrate."
    - general:
        meals 3..4
        snacks 0..1
        notes "Keep consistent meal timing day-to-day to aid glycaemic control."
  CARB_STRATEGY:
    type "low-GI emphasis"
    daily_carbs 150..170 g
    fiber 28..35 g
    notes "Prioritize legumes, oats, berries, non-starchy vegetables; limit refined sugars and juices."
  FOOD_LISTS:
    proteins:
      - "chicken breast"
      - "turkey"
      - "white fish"
      - "salmon"
      - "eggs"
      - "greek yogurt (unsweetened)"
      - "tofu"
      - "tempeh"
      - "cottage cheese (low-fat)"
    carbs_low_gi:
      - "steel-cut oats"
      - "quinoa"
      - "brown rice"
      - "lentils"
      - "chickpeas"
      - "black beans"
      - "berries"
      - "apples"
      - "pears"
      - "whole-grain bread (high fiber)"
      - "sweet potato"
      - "non-starchy vegetables"
    fats:
      - "olive oil"
      - "avocado"
      - "nuts"
      - "seeds"
      - "nut butter (no added sugar)"
    limit:
      - "sugary drinks"
      - "refined pastries"
      - "candy"
      - "fried foods"
      - "alcohol >1 drink/day"
  HYDRATION:
    water 2.0..2.7 L
    sodium "add a pinch to water if training in heat"
  MICRONUTRIENTS:
    emphasis:
      - "magnesium-rich foods (legumes, nuts, greens)"
      - "potassium-rich foods (leafy greens, beans)"
      - "vitamin D and omega-3 from fish; consider lab-guided supplementation"
  DIABETES_CONSIDERATIONS:
    metformin "continue as prescribed; take with meals to reduce GI upset"
    monitoring:
      - "Check fasting glucose most mornings."
      - "For workouts >45m or with intervals, check glucose pre and 1–2 h post."
      - "Carry fast-acting carbs (e.g., glucose tabs) if readings trend low."
    targets:
      pre_meal_glucose "80–130 mg/dL"
      post_meal_1_2h "<180 mg/dL"
    adjustments:
      - "If pre-workout glucose <90 mg/dL, add 10–15 g low-GI carbs."
      - "If post-meal >180 mg/dL consistently, reduce carbs by 10–15% and increase non-starchy vegetables."
  SAMPLE_DAY:
    meal1:
      time "07:30"
      items:
        - "omelet with 2 eggs, spinach, mushrooms, olive oil"
        - "steel-cut oats 40 g dry with cinnamon and berries"
        - "black coffee or tea (unsweetened)"
      macros:
        calories 450
        protein 28 g
        carbs 45 g
        fats 16 g
    meal2:
      time "12:30"
      items:
        - "grilled chicken salad: mixed greens, tomatoes, cucumber, chickpeas, olive oil + lemon"
        - "apple"
      macros:
        calories 450
        protein 35 g
        carbs 40 g
        fats 16 g
    pre_workout_snack:
      time "16:30"
      items:
        - "greek yogurt (170 g) with chia seeds and blueberries"
      macros:
        calories 250
        protein 20 g
        carbs 28 g
        fats 6 g
    meal3:
      time "19:00"
      items:
        - "baked salmon 120 g"
        - "quinoa 120 g cooked"
        - "roasted broccoli and carrots"
      macros:
        calories 520
        protein 35 g
        carbs 45 g
        fats 22 g
  BEHAVIOURAL_GOALS:
    - "Aim 7–8 h sleep; consistent wake/bed times."
    - "10–12k steps on non-lifting days."
    - "Log meals and glucose; review weekly trends."
    - "Limit alcohol to ≤1 drink/day and avoid around training days."
  PROGRESSION_NOTES:
    - "Increase load when all top-end reps achieved at prescribed RPE for two consecutive sessions."
    - "If RPE exceeds target by >1 for two sets, reduce load 5% next set."
    - "During deload weeks (4, 8, 12), reduce volume and intensity as programmed."
  SAFETY_NOTES:
    - "Perform longer warmups to reduce hypoglycaemia risk; avoid fasted high-intensity intervals."
    - "Rotate rowing and cycling for low-impact options; avoid excessive jumping."
    - "Stop if dizziness, unusual shortness of breath, or chest pain occur; check glucose and seek care if needed."
